meta.title: KATTOBASE | Hiroshima Baseball Watching Guide
meta.description: An unofficial guide for international travelers watching Hiroshima Toyo Carp baseball at Mazda Stadium for the first time.
hero.title: Welcome to Hiroshima, the City of Carp!
hero.city: Hiroshima is a city in western Japan. Known for the World Heritage Site Itsukushima Shrine and Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, it is also a city that passionately supports its local baseball team, the Hiroshima Toyo Carp.
hero.purpose: This site provides essential information for travelers attending a baseball game in Hiroshima for the first time.
hero.disclaimer: This is an unofficial guide created by an individual. Ticket details, stadium opening times, events, and rules may change. Please always check official information on the day of your visit.
